name: world-of-sofia
description: Nuxt showroom for isolated philosopher-derived skills.

scripts.dev: npm --workspace packages/catalog run build && npm --workspace apps/showroom run dev
scripts.build: npm --workspace packages/catalog run build && npm --workspace apps/showroom run build
scripts.deploy: npm --workspace packages/catalog run build && npm --workspace apps/showroom run deploy
scripts.lint: npm --workspace packages/catalog run lint && npm --workspace apps/showroom run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace packages/catalog run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/showroom run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run validate:skills && npm run check:isolation
scripts.test: npm run test:pattern-code-wittgenstein && npm --workspace packages/catalog run test && npm --workspace apps/showroom run test
